`lift_cubin_to_ptx` normally reaches this helper with instructions from `SassDisassembler`, whose binary decoders leave both `data_type` and `modifiers` empty (`ptx/src/sass/disassembler.rs:341-347, 437-443`). A binary CUBIN containing `F2FP.BF16.PACK_AB` therefore still takes the `f16x2` fallback; this fix only works for cuobjdump text input. Please preserve the BF16 metadata in the binary path or explicitly route that path through a semantic disassembler before relying on this branch.

This issue also appears on line 2249 of the same file.
